rv.q: In Joey Curatolo's mountingly enjoyable production, there are two bands who share performing duties across the week.
I wish they really had all just let it be.
In terms of the West End’s theatres this is, quite literally, a waste of space.

cn.t: Critics are sharply divided on this Beatles tribute concert, with praise for the music itself but significant criticism of the show's theatrical substance and execution as a stage production.
